fields.name: cni_provider
fields.label: CONTAINER NETWORK INTERFACE PROVIDER
fields.help: Container Networking Configuration. Defaults to Flannel.

fields.name: k8s_api_endpoint
fields.label: VIRTUAL IP
fields.help: Virtual IP i.e 192.168.1.100 for your master nodes. Not required for a Single-Master node. Verify that firewalls allow connectivity between the VIP and all nodes.

fields.name: k8s_master_count
fields.label: MASTER NODE COUNT
fields.help: Number of Master Nodes. Select 3 or More for HA (Requires VIP).

fields.name: master_network
fields.label: MASTER NETWORK
fields.help: If different from worker's network, ensure reachability by appropriate routing of both networks, i.e. two networks on the same router, and ensure security groups for both allows themselves. For availability across availability zones, use 'Network Groups' which uses a 'Round Robin' algorithm.

fields.name: master_plan
fields.label: MASTER PLAN
fields.help: Note: MK8S Master Node Instances require at least 2GB of CPU and memory (i.e., at least the G2S2 Plan)

fields.name: single_node_cluster
fields.label: SINGLE NODE CLUSTER? IF CHECKED, MASTER TAINT IS REMOVED & WORKER NODE WILL NOT PROVISION.

fields.name: worker_network
fields.label: WORKER NETWORK
fields.help: If different from master's network, ensure reachability by appropriate routing of both networks, i.e. two networks on the same router, and ensure security groups for both allows themselves. For availability across availability zones, use 'Network Groups' which uses a 'Round Robin' algorithm.

fields.name: worker_plan
fields.label: WORKER PLAN
fields.help: If left unselected, master plan will be inherited

fields.name: worker_volumes
fields.label: WORKER VOLUMES
fields.help: If left unselected, master volume will be inherited
